name: Arduino UNO Q (2 GB)
description: Dual-brain Uno-format board: Qualcomm QRB2210 running Debian plus an STM32U585 real-time MCU on 3.3 V Uno headers, with WiFi 5, BLE and an LED matrix.
notes: The MCU side (STM32U585, Cortex-M33 at 160 MHz, 2 MB flash, 786 KB RAM) runs Arduino Core on Zephyr; Linux, WiFi 5/BT 5.1, MIPI-CSI/DSI and the 2 GB LPDDR4 + 16 GB eMMC belong to the QRB2210 MPU.
Price rose from $44 to $59 in July 2026 (2 GB); the 4 GB / 32 GB variant is $79.
UNO headers are 3.3 V logic (A0, A1 and D3 are not 5 V tolerant); VIN 7-24 V; USB-C with PD and DisplayPort Alt-Mode. 8x13 blue LED matrix and Qwiic connector.
GPIO count covers D0-D13, D20/D21 (I2C), A0-A5 and the 3 dedicated JSPI pins; JMISC/JMEDIA expose more MCU and MPU signals.
